title: Namespaces
lead: One Tuck per bank segment, one namespace per team. Each team's secrets, policies and auth methods live in their own enclosure and never see their neighbours.

card.isolated: own enclosure: secrets, policies and auth methods are hidden from neighbours

noMatch.title: Nothing found
noMatch.text: No namespaces match "{{q}}". Check the name or reset the filter.

empty.title: Create your first namespace
empty.text: Everything lives in the root for now. Set up an enclosure for the first team: it gets its own secrets, policies and auth methods, and other data stays out of reach.
empty.s1d: A name like team-a: lowercase latin letters, digits and hyphens.
empty.s2d: Make it current: requests will carry the X-Tuck-Namespace header.
empty.s3d: Inside, the enclosure has its own secrets, policies and auth methods.

forbidden.title: The enclosure list is not for you
forbidden.text: Only a token with rights on sys/namespaces can list and create namespaces.
forbidden.bound: Your token is bound to namespace {{ns}}.

error.title: Could not load the list
error.message: The server did not respond or returned an error. Check the connection and retry.

createModal.title: New namespace
createModal.hint: Namespaces isolate secrets, policies and auth methods per tenant.
createModal.name: Name
createModal.errChars: Lowercase latin letters, digits and hyphens only; the name must not start with a hyphen.

deleteModal.title: Delete namespace?
deleteModal.warn: Secrets and policies stay in storage but become inaccessible until the namespace is recreated.
deleteModal.current: This is your current context: after deletion the page returns to root.
